name: Emma Barrera
source: Emma is one of the most easy-going human beings one can meet. She's a free soul, and she wanders through life like a leaf moved by the wind, always with a smile and positive attitude, open to experience what the world has to offer. Even though she was a couple of years younger than Ian and Perry, she played in a band with them while they were in high school, and they have been friends ever since. She's always moving and making new friends, so it can be hard to see her sometimes, much to Perry's discontent.
